sources.quote: HAT-P-8b is an extrasolar planet located approximately 720 light years away in the constellation of Pegasus, orbiting the 10th magnitude star GSC 02757-01152.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-8. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
